heading: Trade publication pitches
description: Six ready-to-send pitch emails for the top beauty and salon trade publications. Each pitch is pre-filled with the publication name, relevant section, and a tailored angle. Click any row to expand the full email, then copy and send.

items.text: Send Tuesday–Thursday, 9–11 AM in the editor's timezone for best open rates.
Replace [Editor's name] with the actual editor's name — check the masthead or LinkedIn.
Follow up once after 7 days if no reply. Keep it to one sentence: "Just wanted to bump this up in case it got buried."
Offer a free trial account in every pitch — editors are far more likely to cover tools they can actually test.
Link to certxa.com/about in your email signature so editors can see the founder story before replying.
